leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct JavaScript objects using both literal syntax and constructor functions
Manipulate object properties by adding, updating, and deleting key-value pairs
Implement inheritance by linking objects through prototype chains
Configure class definitions with constructors, methods, and static properties
Initialize class instances and apply inheritance using the 'extends' keyword
Integrate prototype methods to extend functionality across multiple objects
Control object behavior through property descriptors and accessor methods
